// REQ: LANG-651 LANG-652 LANG-653 LANG-654 `timescale 1ns / 1ps `define WIDTH 8 /* A simple counter. */ module counter #(parameter WIDTH = `WIDTH) ( input wire clk, input wire rst_n, output reg [WIDTH-1:0] count ); localparam MAX = 8'hFF; always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin if (!rst_n) count <= 'b0; else if (count == MAX) count <= {WIDTH{1'b0}}; else count <= count + 4'sd1; end initial begin $display("counter width = %0d", WIDTH); end endmodule
